svg.title: New controls, on both sides.
svg.desc: The v2.3.6 sharing and remote-screen docks are captured from the verified release package. Both begin as a small line. Hover opens the new flat controls, and right-click opens the matching dock settings. Enlarged captures below show the actual current controls. Sample connections are used; unavailable performance statistics are left unset.
svg.text: Hover for the controls. Right-click for the dock settings.
Captured from the v2.3.6 release package. Sample connections; statistics unset.
